text:
natalie: Heads-up — we need a short, actionable runbook for triaging CVE-2026-4387 (moderate exploitability) in our runtime deps. Can we map owners + patch SLA?

owen: I can own runtime-libs for the initial triage. Will confirm affected versions and PoC presence.

sasha: I’ll handle release-side impact (Dedicated & Private). Need the risk matrix: data-plane vs control-plane.

prateek: Quick thought — prioritize by: 1) exploitability, 2) blast radius, 3) public PoC. We should aim for hotfix within 72h for moderate+ with PoC.

julie: FYI: sec-triage-bot created SEC-4321 and attached vendor advisory.

sec-bot: SEC-4321 created by @julie. Labels: severity:moderate, component:runtime-libs, status:open. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-4321

own: Triage checklist (short):
```
- Confirm affected versions and service impact
- Reproduce exploit (if PoC) in sandbox
- Determine mitigation (upgrade / backport / config change)
- Estimate rollout risk and downtime
- Assign PR owner and test plan
```

prateek: For SLA table proposal:
- Critical (RCE, data exfil): 8h owner contact, 24h mitigated
- High (auth bypass, high-impact DoS): 24h contact, 48h mitigated
- Moderate w/ PoC: 48h contact, 72h mitigated
- Moderate no PoC: 5 business days

sasha: Agreed. For Dedicated customers we escalate one tier faster and notify account teams. Add communication template.

julie: Ownership handoff pattern:
- Triage owner (first responder) opens SEC ticket + labels
- Component owner assigned within 2h (or oncall escalates)
- Release owner + SRE looped for rollout plan

natalie: @owen @prateek can you confirm who does patch PR + who signs off for canary? We want explicit names.

own: I’ll do the patch PR for runtime-libs if it’s a straight upgrade. @sasha sign-off for Dedicated rollout.

prateek: I’ll do canary monitoring and rollback hooks. Suggested metrics: error-rate, latency P95, token-success-rate (for generation).

julie: Add escalation ladder:
- 1: triage owner
- 2: component lead
- 3: security oncall (if >24h unresolved or PoC public)
- 4: CTO brief (if customer impact > 1% or data exposure)

sec-bot: Reminder: attach audit logs & KMS usage details to SEC-4321. Use tag `kms-keys` if key rotation considered.

natalie: On KMS + RBAC: if patch requires key rotation, follow these steps:
```
1) Create new key version in KMS (staging)
2) Update service config in staging, run smoke tests
3) Roll keys in canary nodes, monitor errors
4) Rotate globally if stable, keep old key for 7d for rollback
```

prateek: For emergency RBAC elevation (short-lived): use the emergency role and audit every change. Example (internal):
`gcloud iam roles add-iam-policy-binding roles/emergencyPatch --member=user:someone@redwood.com`
Make sure change is recorded in audit logs and crosschecked by SRE.

julie: Also add post-deploy QA: run regression prompt-set for generation endpoints, run embeddings smoke tests, and run a random sampling of customer flows.

owen: Test checklist for PR: unit tests, integration tests in staging, load canary at 10% traffic for 30m, then 50% for 1h, then full if green. Include rollback commands in PR description.

natalie: I'll update the internal runbook doc with the SLA table, ownership handoff, KMS snippet, and a short communication template. Draft link: https://redwood.internal/docs/sec/triage-playbook-draft

sasha: One more: add a note on dependency pinning policy and backport expectations for minor versions. We should avoid blanket pinning that blocks security fixes.

prateek: Can someone add pre-approved emergency approvers list to the ticket so we can bypass slow approvals during hotfix windows?

julie: Added `approvers: ["natalie","owen","sasha","prateek"]` to SEC-4321.

sec-bot: SEC-4321 updated: approvers list added, playbook draft linked.

natalie: Great work. Next actions: @owen open the patch PR within 6h, @prateek prepare canary metrics dashboard, @sasha prep Dedicated rollout plan. I'll close the loop and publish runbook after PR lands. :thumbsup:

owen: On it.

prateek: Will have dashboard ready in ~4h.

sasha: Preparing rollout doc now.

julie: I’ll drive external communication template for affected customers.

natalie: Thanks team — keeping this thread for updates. If anything blocks, ping security-oncall.
